hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 singleton hook that runs a permissionless buyback pot per pool. After every swap, it uses donated secondary-token balance to buy the pool's configured main asset and delivers it to a recipient (default: burn/address(0)). Optionally runs an auto-compounding LP fee program with configurable fee splits (compound, pot refuel, burn, recipient). All hook actions are wrapped in try/catch so swapper execution is never blocked.
